summary: Ford Credit Floorplan LLC and Ford Credit Floorplan Corporation, as depositors, filed an 8-K reporting an Underwriting Agreement dated October 6, 2026 with the underwriters for an issuance of asset-backed notes by Ford Credit Floorplan Master Owner Trust A, plus the required Form SF-3 CEO certification. The filing is a routine securitization shelf takedown, not a special situation; no stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, or advisor is stated. Watch closing mechanics, note pricing, and any dealer floorplan collateral performance disclosures.
